title: Behavioral cessation interventions for pregnant persons who use tobacco

source.quote: The USPSTF recommends that clinicians ask all pregnant persons about tobacco use, advise them to stop using tobacco, and provide behavioral interventions for cessation to pregnant persons who use tobacco.

action: Provide behavioral interventions for cessation to pregnant persons who use tobacco

all.note: intended: pregnant at some point during the measurement year

derived.window: text states no interval; measurement year used as a proxy for 'during pregnancy'
